answer: Each agent can open only one credit line after anchoring a scarce, nontransferable deposit to a verified device and a randomly assigned human sponsor. When agents trade, counterparties sign the same transaction thread; a rotating jury audits a sample against delivery records, and proven duplicate identities forfeit their deposits and the sponsor’s bond. An orchard of independent sponsors makes collusion harder, while an old relic of a deposit cannot be reused: each attempted fake identity ties up new capital and risks losing it.
